# Open Duck Mini calibration (challenge-2 rows 1 and 11)

Open Duck Mini's Playground and reference-motion repositories have NO LICENSE: read from a scratch folder at run time, nothing copied or committed; only derived numbers are recorded here.

Walking gates, worst LEG joint, 7.4 V STS3215 model (stall 1.912 N.m, rated 0.49 / 0.637 N.m), ODM's own armature 0.027 where its MJCF is used. No gate threshold is changed. 'a/gate' = value / gate = how much looser the gate would have to be for that robot-and-gait to pass.

- (b) flex 77.0 deg, step time 0.5 s, ZMP 0.05 m inboard, IK failures 0
- (c) flex 77.0 deg, step time 0.5 s, ZMP 0.03 m inboard, feasible True
- (d) flex 45.0 deg, step time 0.5 s, feasible True

ODM's training sim vs the gates: ODM's training sim lets each servo deliver 3.23 N.m (and kp 13.37 N.m/rad); the 7.4 V datasheet stall the gates use is 1.912 N.m
